name: Nien Made Enterprise Co., LTD.
summary: Nien Made Enterprise Co., LTD. engages in the research, development, design, manufacture, and sale of various types of window coverings and related components in the United States, Europe, and internationally. It offers various types of blinds, shutters, shades, and related components; wood blinds and shutter semi-products; smart drape; cellular, roman, and roller shades; plastic blinds and accessories; and chair covers. The company also designs, manufactures, and sells automated appliances and PVC tubes.
